svg.aria-label: second-brain, one capture end to end: Serif Longform Reader is shared from an app, a vision model reads it, files it under design/style-paper-ink and lifts its palette, the swatches become the Paper and Ink DESIGN.md tokens, and a card paints itself with them, ending on the #d9481f primary button.
